instruction: Choose exactly one allowed action. latestAttribution.cause: Equipping the epic boots on the berserker raised displayed equipped power from 697 to 753, a gain of 56, while adding health and armor to a key attacker.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Challenge main stage 8 and see whether the better-protected damage core can remove its fragile casters before they cause another near-wipe.

latestAttribution.cause: The prepared lineup quickly eliminated main stage 8's fragile ranged group in 9.12 seconds with all four allies alive and unlocked a new assassin.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Try the newly unlocked assassin in place of the zero-damage berserker while keeping the three heroes that completed this fast clear.

latestAttribution.cause: Equipping the epic helm on the mage raised displayed equipped power from 630 to 697, a gain of 67.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Challenge main stage 7 and observe whether the newly protected mage survives the single high-health bear encounter.

latestAttribution.cause: Equipping the armor-breaking gloves on the warrior raised displayed equipped power from 523 to 630, a gain of 107.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Restore the berserker for more direct damage before retrying, because the bard's support-skill test succeeded but the bard ranked fourth in damage during the full defeat.

hypotheses.problem: I do not yet know whether the newly visible drummer helps progression more than the incomplete spear militia.
hypotheses.cause: The drummer may trade weak personal damage for a useful team-wide buff.

hypotheses.problem: The team depends heavily on the warrior for damage and the barricade militia has contributed very little damage.
hypotheses.cause: The newly rescued complete mage may add more reliable damage than the incomplete barricade militia.

hypotheses.problem: The drummer's direct combat contribution fell to the lowest rank in the last fight.
hypotheses.cause: The newly rescued berserker may add stronger damage than the drummer while the healer offsets some of its visible low-health risk.

hypotheses.problem: The herb militia contributed little damage and died in the prison, while the newly unlocked ranger is untested.
hypotheses.cause: The ranger's sustained ranged attacks may add more reliable combat contribution than the herb militia provided.

hypotheses.problem: The berserker's recent damage rank has varied, while the newly unlocked full bard has no evidence.
hypotheses.cause: The bard may contribute through repeated team-support skills even without high personal damage.
